assertionReview.proves: Real pinned pnpm pack and POSIX tar extraction; one archive per pack directory; packed package names/versions are machine identities. Workspace code is renamed from extracted tarballs into the independent node_modules, never symlinked from checkout. No archive filename or internal main/types/export layout is the success oracle.

Only explicitly supplied existing third-party dependencies are linked. Original workspace: dependency specs cannot enter this fallback. Packed workspace versions must equal their actual dependency artifacts. This is local deterministic supply, not a registry installation.

assertionReview.scope: kernel native CJS and ESM probe
assertionReview.proves: Representative existing public root/subpaths load with native require and import; resolved real paths remain inside this consumer. Tool success/parser output is exact supplied data plus protocol fields. Event channel delivers supplied opaque data; HTML escaping is machine serialization. No manual title, fallback prose or package description is judged.

Actual Node resolution rejects kernel/dist, shell/cli, dominds root and dominds/dist/server with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED. Error code is a resolver machine contract; no diagnostic prose is matched.

Fresh strict NodeNext projects have no extends/paths, no ambient type packages, and skipLibCheck false. They use actual published CLI signatures and representative kernel state/event/language/host compatibility contracts. No source import spelling inside the repository is required.

After positive native and compiler runs, move the whole kernel package aside. A fresh native process must fail status1 and a fresh compiler must fail status2 with no signal. A timeout, signal death or missing executable is not accepted as the expected refusal. These controls test fallback isolation, not diagnostic prose.

The packed public dominds/cli exports callable main and the real bin completes --help in a fresh native child. This tests startup and exit only; no meaning claim about the help text. Actual root/kernel/shell/auth resolution is inside the consumer.

The actual packed certificate module and its declared selfsigned dependency generate a certificate for a supplied IP and a matching private key. Native X509/IP/key checks judge cryptographic facts. Runtime PATH is empty, so no system OpenSSL executable can satisfy this effect. The user home directory is not changed or used for outputs.

The actual packed static handler serves index and its linked JS/CSS/icon resources through a real local HTTP server. Status and response bytes equal the given packed files. HTML src/href regex extracts machine resource addresses only; it judges no natural-language meaning and is not a semantic-test detector. No browser/rendering/user interaction coverage claimed.

Native probes/compiler errors propagate to the case, suite continues and records every attempted case; nonzero or timeout fails. Isolated temporary installations retain failed artifacts. Shared test runner cleans successful state. No retry-until-green or timeout increase.

Old source snippets/import regexes, vanished paths, exact dependency/script/file recipes and an empty runtime-export set were inspected and removed. Actual public import/packaged effects preserve useful value; no promise that release authentication or every existing kernel diagnostic is covered. The low-value shell description equality is deleted, not converted to a semantic review.

Each native probe emits one machine packet only after every action awaits completion; the parent requires the exact protocol identifier and actual fixture identity. This prevents an unresolved async main with no live Node handles from silently exiting zero. It is an execution protocol, never a prose-quality comparison.

failureHistory.resolution: Remove the entire installed kernel package for the negative control; accept legitimate internal declaration layout choices. Real product unchanged.

failureHistory.actualResult: Initial root and kernel exploratory processes overlapped; pnpm pack for the root executes its existing prepare lifecycle.
failureHistory.resolution: Those outputs are not the final serial acceptance. Formal packaging suite executes root then kernel; final complete suite passed with empty runtime PATH.

failureHistory.meaning: A native async main awaiting an unresolved promise exits zero without reaching its completion write. Exit alone cannot prove the consumer executed its assertions.
failureHistory.resolution: Both native probes now send an explicit machine completion packet at the end; the parent requires exactly one. Final full packaging suite and full test type check were rerun after this correction.
